_comment: Self-authorization / rules-of-engagement for the active-testing layer. orchestrator.gates.Authorization.from_file() reads this; every active request is gated against `allowlist`. For testing YOUR OWN apps, list your own domains/IPs here. Copy to authorization.json (gitignored) and edit.
notes: Safe-by-default: non-destructive payloads only, rate-limited. Blind SSRF/XXE need an operator-hosted OAST collaborator (see common/oob.py).
